opening.protocol: First eight training examples; independent Bernoulli pixels fitted to all 60,000 binary training images, seed 667. No selection.

beta_protocol.reduction: BCE summed over 784 pixels; KL summed over 2 latent dimensions; both averaged over examples
beta_protocol.evaluation: One posterior sample per test example. Reconstruction images decode posterior means. Same seeds, initialization and minibatch order across beta. Single seed; instructional comparison, not a benchmark.
